ai_policy.summary: The journal permits disclosed use to develop portions of a manuscript subject to editorial discretion and human responsibility. Applicable Wiley AI guidance on research and analysis could not be read in full: the publisher page returned 403; a search snippet alone does not establish the required research and analysis permission.

disclosure.instructions: Journal requires transparent detailed disclosure of manuscript development in Methods or Acknowledgements; ordinary spelling, grammar and general editing are exempt. Research and analysis instructions from the blocked Wiley page could not be independently verified.

restrictions: Editor decides whether a particular use is appropriate; AI cannot be an author; humans verify accuracy and sources.

policy_sources.note: Journal permits manuscript development with disclosure and reserves editorial discretion.

patches.audit_note: Downgraded AI compatibility because substantive research and analysis evidence was accessible only as a snippet; journal-level writing permission and disclosure remain.
Official instructions describe no-fee open access, welcome all relevant scholars, and explicitly waive association membership; no explicit AI policy or official metric located.
Official journal about page supports no author payments; ethics page addresses data analysis and editing but does not expressly permit substantive drafting.

ai_policy.summary: The journal explicitly encourages responsible AI use and gives an example of AI-generated first drafts; applicable Elsevier policy permits research design, analysis and code development with human judgment and transparent methods. AI drafting is prohibited for Letters to the Editor, but the policy gives a first-draft example for other manuscripts.

disclosure.instructions: Journal requires a use or no-use statement on the title page and immediately before references, identifying tool, purpose and human oversight; describe research methods and analysis reproducibly in Methods.

restrictions: Authors retain scientific judgment and responsibility; AI cannot be an author; comply with applicable image restrictions.
AI use for drafting Letters to the Editor is prohibited; this article-type restriction overrides general drafting permission.

policy_sources.note: Journal-specific instructions give first-draft example, require declarations and refer authors to Elsevier policy.
Publisher policy permits research design, code and analysis; requires reproducible methods and human oversight.

findings.issue: Journal expressly prohibits AI drafting for Letters to the Editor; inherited AI record omitted this limitation. Current society instructions describe unpaid non-OA articles, but do not establish all submission or other mandatory charges.
findings.resolution: Add article-type restriction; retain needs_verification for complete cost route and not_stated author eligibility.

notes: Reviewed all eight discovery candidates and each completed fee, geography and AI policy file. Citation metrics do not predict individual acceptance. No baseline records exist for this field.

Official Wiley journal homepage timed out and Wiley AI guidelines returned HTTP 403; indexed official search content was used only for labeled metric values, not to establish AI compatibility. Journal author instructions were readable.

No official citation or acceptance metric was established for Asian Pacific Journal of Health Economics and Policy or Epidemiology, Biostatistics, and Public Health. Source silence is not proof that none exists.
